maria_sales: Heads up — AcmeHealth POC final run scheduled TOMORROW 09:00 PT. They want a run that shows 95th/99th tail-latency at our promised throughput plus a cost delta table for burst vs reserved. Also flagged security: they want SAML + VPC isolation for the POC. Can we confirm load plan, pricing numbers, and what we can provide for SAML/VPC for a two-week trial?
ben_infra: +1. I drafted a load plan below based on their expected 120 rps steady, bursts to 600 rps for 5m every 30m. Suggested test phases: smoke (5m @ 120rps), steady (30m @ 120rps), burst soak (5 cycles of 5m bursts), long-tail (2h at 100rps with random spikes).
ben_infra: Example runner command we used:```
rbench --model redwood-ggml-13b-q4 --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --concurrency 48 --qps 120 --duration 1800 --burst-pattern "600@5m:every30m"
```
lee_engineer: For tail-latency we need KV cache warmup before steady stage, otherwise 99p will spike. Recommend 15m warmup @30% traffic with repeated prefixes. Also enable prefix caching on the route.
lee_engineer: On infra side, set batching cap to 64 tokens and max-batch-wait to 6ms for the steady stage; increase max-batch-wait to 15ms during bursts to avoid queue drops. Those knobs drop p99 by ~120ms in our internal runs.
anna_security: We can do SAML SSO for the POC — need their IdP metadata and a test user. For VPC isolation we provide a private endpoint and temporary VPC peering for the two-week window; KMS-backed key for logs/encryption is also available but requires a short onboarding form. I can send the security checklist snippet they asked for.
sam_ae: Pricing: can you give me both 1) estimated token cost for the run and 2) a monthly reserved vs burst delta if they want guaranteed 24/7 baseline + bursts? I need numbers to put on the quote.
ben_infra: Quick cost math (rough): steady 120 rps * avg 30 tokens/request * 3600s * 0.5h = wait put per-hour calc -> better: per-hour tokens at 120 rps * 30 tokens * 3600 = 12,960,000 tokens/hr. For a 48-hour comprehensive POC run (including warmups & soak) that's ~622M tokens. At hosted rate $0.0008 per 1k tokens => ~$497. For reserved capacity (committed) monthly baseline sized for 120 rps we'd price lower unit cost; burst capacity billed at on-demand + small burst premium. I'll attach a detailed spreadsheet.
maria_sales: Nice, can you shorten that into a slide for the customer? Also, Anna — please paste the minimal checklist items we can share immediately (IdP metadata, contact, whether they need HSM).
anna_security: Minimal checklist: 1) IdP metadata XML, 2) test SP-initiated login URL, 3) list of admin users, 4) data residency (region), 5) whether they require HSM (yes/no). I'll DM the full doc but paste snippet in thread: ```We support SAML 2.0 (IdP metadata + ACS URL), VPC peering or privatelink endpoint, KMS-managed keys; SOC2 & ISO27001 attestation available on request.```
ops-bot: [system] Provision request accepted: 4 x p4d-like instances (provisioned to sandbox) for scheduled test window 2027-03-05 09:00 PT to 2027-03-07 09:00 PT.
ben_infra: For the runbook: I'll spin up test harness with two worker groups — group A handles steady 120 rps (48 concurrency), group B simulates bursts (250 concurrency) routed via canary so we can compare latency across variants. I'll capture per-route token/time breakdown.
lee_engineer: Quick note on metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99, token/sec, queue depth, batch size distribution, model GPU util, and KV-cache hit rate. Also capture per-request prompt size so we can normalize cost.
sam_ae: Thanks — once you post the cost spreadsheet I'll draft a short customer email with the expected numbers and timelines. Can we also include an explicit SLA for the POC window (uptime target)?
maria_sales: Yes, propose 99% uptime for the POC window and include a rollback/fallback to smaller model if we see persistent degradation. I'll draft the customer message after Ben posts the run outputs. :thumbsup:
lee_engineer: I'll run a short internal smoke right now to sanity-check the harness; will post quick numbers in thread in ~30m.
ben_infra: Copy — I'll upload the runbook and the cost sheet to the sales folder once smoke completes.
sam_ae: FYI I'll be on the call tomorrow, can someone drop the call link here?
maria_sales: Call link: https://meet.redwood.example/acme-poc-2027-03-05  See you all.
ops-bot: [system] Smoke harness completed: 120rps steady 10m -> p95=210ms, p99=460ms (model redwood-ggml-13b-q4), KV-cache hit=82%. Artifacts uploaded: /shared/sales/acme/poc/smoke-2102345678.csv
lee_engineer: Quick reaction: p99 a bit high — try bumping batching cap to 80 and warmup longer. Ben — can you re-run burst soak after tweak?
ben_infra: On it. Will rerun and update sheet.
sam_ae: Great thread — keeping customer in copy after we finalize numbers.
maria_sales: Thanks team, appreciated.
